test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, name String, INDEX idx(name) TYPE text(tokenizer = array) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, if(number % 1000 = 0, format('alpha-service-{}-prod', number), format('beta-service-{}-dev', number)) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%service-4999-%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4999%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%service-4999-prod'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%alpha%4999%prod%'
